name: Smart Button [Milesight]
description: Milesight WS101 smart button (codec ws101-decoder.js, fPort 85): `button_event.status` is 'short press' / 'long press' / 'double press', sent once per press; `battery` is a percentage (not volts), so there are no battery alarms. Latching: short press = ON (alarm), long press = OFF (clears), double press = not used. Frames that carry no press (battery, status) change nothing.
